findings.rule: When a sentence gives the cause, consequence or exception of the one before, say so with a connective.
findings.input:
The render masks each term in the store data it embeds with the term's label in square brackets,
so a published event that carries a term stays in the log and never reaches the page.
findings.finding: The added sentence joins its clauses with "so", but masking does not cause the event to stay in the log, so the connective misstates the cause and the consequence.

findings.rule: Bring the verb within four words of its subject, with no clause between verb and complement.

findings.rule: Keep a code comment to one or two sentences that give the reason rather than the mechanism.

findings.rule: Break new or rewritten prose at sentence or clause boundaries, one per line.
